credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Kathy Porter and Doris Bry sitting on a metal chest at the river's edge with paper plates in their laps. Doris Bry is drinking from a white coffee cup.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Kathy Porter and Doris Bry
